comments.text:
I was an ER nurse, associates degree. When I started nursing I always heard go back right away or you won’t do it. Then I got to my job and realized that the BSN nurses only made a dollar more an hour. No wonder nurses don’t go back. I did the math. It would take 34 years at 36 hours a week, to pay off a $15,000 student loan I would need to take out to get that BSN, not counting interest. Unless I wanted to become a manager, which I did not, it wasn’t even worth it.
I am still a nurse, but I work from home. I don’t make as much as I could make bedside, but I make my schedule, and am relatively stress free.
One thing I noticed no one talks about is the PTSD. The memories I have from people dying, people with absolutely grotesque injuries, the screams of the families. They will never leave me.
